name: Google Workspace Business Starter
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Google Workspace Business Starter, host basic video rooms and team documents without recreating Google's collaboration suite. The hard boundary is google identity, meet infrastructure, gmail, drive, docs, admin, and global operations, plus real-time media infrastructure and reliability.
